correctness.rationale: For any positive angular sample design, frame-matrix diagonal is fixed at W e^{-x} x^k/k!. Rayleigh inequalities give the ratio lower bound, log concavity and endpoint balance give unique x=(n!)^(1/n), and equality forces every Fourier angular moment 1..n to vanish. Vandermonde square-unitary argument classifies the n+1-site equality designs. Stirling yields precise exponential asymptotic. A standalone finite checker tests 400 consistency assertions without being used as an infinite proof.

The motivating new continuous-frame theorem is an unrestricted planar existence theorem, not a fixed-radius obstruction. value.rationale: A complete minimax obstruction, optimizer placement classification, and sharp exponential instability law for all positive weighted single-radius coherent measurements of every finite-degree Fock polynomial space. It quantitatively identifies why varying angular nodes or increasing their number cannot recover almost-tightness, and determines the unique minimal-cardinality design as a regular polygon. This precise natural engineering/math invariant is beyond a finite small-case computation.
